qSQL select.description: select: rows of a table that pass a filter, as a table

qSQL select by.description: select ... by: one row per group, as a keyed table

qSQL update.description: update: new or changed columns on the rows that pass a filter

qSQL update by.description: update ... by: a column computed within each group, one value per row

qSQL exec.description: exec: one column as a list, or several as a dictionary

qSQL exec by.description: exec ... by: a dictionary from each group to its values

qSQL delete rows.description: delete ... where: the table without the rows that pass a filter

qSQL delete columns.description: delete cols from: the table without the named columns

Functional select.description: ?[t;c;b;a]: select with the table, constraints, grouping and aggregates as data

Functional update.description: ![t;c;b;a]: update with the table, constraints, grouping and assignments as data

Protected evaluation, one argument.description: @[f;x;handler]: call f on x, and hand an error's text to the handler instead of signalling it

Protected evaluation, several arguments.description: .[f;args;handler]: call f on a list of arguments, and hand an error's text to the handler

each.description: f each x: f on every item of x

peach.description: f peach x: f on every item of x, across the secondary threads or processes

each-both.description: x f' y: f on the items of x and y pairwise

each-left.description: x f\: y: f on every item of x, each with the whole of y

each-right.description: x f/: y: f on the whole of x with every item of y

each-prior.description: (f':) x: f on every item of x and the one before it

Conditional.description: $[c;t;f]: t when c is true, otherwise f - only the branch taken is evaluated

Conditional, several tests.description: $[c1;t1;c2;t2;f]: the result paired with the first test that is true, otherwise the last

if.description: if[c;...]: run the statements when c is true; it has no result

do.description: do[n;...]: run the statements n times

while.description: while[c;...]: run the statements for as long as c is true

Function with a qdoc header.description: A named lambda under a qdoc comment: what it does, each parameter, what it returns

Namespace block.description: \d .ns ... \d .: define what is between in a namespace, then return to the root
